$comment: PUBLIC, COMMITTED scrub-token set. Read by tests/test_scrub_gate.py, which
fails if any token appears as a whole identifier anywhere in the shipped tree.
These are generic 'this must never ship' markers -- deliberately not tied to
any organization, product, or customer. They are chosen so they cannot
false-positive on ordinary prose or Azure resource-type names.
Maintainers and forks add their OWN private tokens (internal product names,
customer names, code names) in tests/.scrub-tokens.private.json, which is
gitignored. That file is optional: the gate always runs with the tokens
below, and additionally loads the private supplement when present. Publishing
the mechanism does not require publishing the private word list -- see
